patches.name: Allow Gearslip
patches.description: Lets Gearslip, the Android Auto alternative, show Waze on the car screen. Waze's car library accepts only Android Auto itself on a phone; this adds Gearslip (and any other host you list) to the hosts it accepts. Android Auto keeps working as before.

options.description: digest,package entries separated by ';'. The digest is the SHA-256 of the host's signing certificate, 64 lowercase hex characters (apksigner verify --print-certs), or * for any certificate.

patches.name: Fix speed drops
patches.description: Stops Waze from showing 0 km/h for a moment while driving on phones without Google Play services. A location without a speed gets one from the distance travelled, or keeps the last speed briefly, and short gaps between locations can be bridged. Real stops are not affected.

options.description: How long the last speed is kept when a location comes without one and its position is too coarse to compute one. After that the speed falls as if braking.
How fast a held speed may fall after the hold time. 4 is firm braking.
When no location arrives while driving, continue along the last heading for at most this many seconds. 0 turns this off.

release_notes:
> [!CAUTION]
> **Written entirely by AI (Claude).** **Fix speed drops** has not been tested in a real car yet. Use at your own risk.

### New: Fix speed drops

Stops Waze from showing 0 km/h for a moment while driving on phones without Google Play services (e.g. GrapheneOS). Waze's location listener is wrapped so that a fix without a speed gets one from the distance travelled, or keeps the last speed briefly; short gaps can be bridged. Real stops are unaffected. Options: hold speed, braking, bridge gaps. See the README.

### Changes

- The extension no longer bundles the Kotlin standard library (2.2 MB smaller, no clash with Waze's own copy).
- `gradle.properties` is now in the repo, so forks build with the right version.

### Patches

- **Allow Gearslip** (unchanged)
- **Fix speed drops** (new)

Target: Waze 5.24.5.0 (APKM), other versions experimental. Patcher: morphe-patcher 1.13.0.
